title: Practice Case Studies (Fictional)
notes: All cases are fictional to support training. These are structured for timeline + evidence + reasoning exercises.

cases.title: Intersection Collision — Conflicting Witness Accounts
cases.scenario_summary: Two vehicles collide at a four-way intersection. Witnesses disagree about who entered on green.

provided_artifacts.summary: Saw Vehicle A enter quickly; unsure about light.
Heard impact; looked up after; believes Vehicle B ran red.
Road dry, visibility moderate, minor skid marks observed.
Nearby camera time drift suspected; timestamp offset uncertain.

training_objectives: Build a timeline with uncertainty flags
List the top 5 additional facts that would reduce uncertainty
analysis_prompts: Which witness is describing direct observation?
How does time drift change interpretation?

cases.title: Repeat Burglary Pattern — Opportunity Cluster
cases.scenario_summary: Three burglaries occur in two weeks in a small neighborhood cluster.

provided_artifacts.summary: Incidents clustered around same time window.
Entry points vary; one has forced entry indication, two do not.
Suspicious vehicle seen; description inconsistent across tips.

training_objectives: Identify opportunity structures and prevention actions
analysis_prompts: What evidence suggests linkage vs coincidence?

cases.title: Internal Fraud — Control Breakdown
cases.scenario_summary: A small organization sees unexplained account discrepancies over 60 days.

provided_artifacts.summary: Repeated access to financial system outside normal hours.
No segregation of duties for approvals.
Approvals requested via informal channel with missing attachments.

analysis_prompts: What is the minimal fact set?
